I reviewed the one commit in the range. I found nothing that should block the PR and two small things worth a follow-up. I have not produced a score: both findings are unconfirmed and I didn't run the two-agent validate/refute step.

**Mode:** fixed range `e51c1262f...HEAD`, read-only. I ran the nine review areas myself instead of spawning one agent per area, because the change is 10 lines. Nothing was modified, installed, run as a test, or posted.

**Scope:** 1 file, +4 −6. Base `e51c1262f` → HEAD `1c3cce426` ("fix(web): right-align Inactive/Read-only badge in account selector sub-rows").

**Repo:** Safe{Wallet} monorepo, TypeScript/Next.js web app, Jest and Storybook. The rules I checked against are in `AGENTS.md` and `apps/web/AGENTS.md`, including the test matrix that says a layout-only change needs a Storybook story.

## Summary

| | |
|---|---|
| Verdict | OK to open. Nothing blocking. |
| Score | None, because nothing was independently checked |
| Findings | 2, both unconfirmed (1 P2, 1 P3) |
| Fix first | Look at a narrow viewport (about 320px) with a Read-only chain that also has a pending count |

**What changed:** in each chain row under a multi-chain safe, the status badge (Inactive/Activating/Read-only) used to sit under the chain name. It now sits on the same line, pushed right by the name, which now has `flex-1 truncate`. With the badge now right-aligned, the existing comment at `MultiChainSafeItemRow.tsx:72` ("right-aligned StatusBadge") matches the code again.

## Findings

**F1 · P2 · layout · unconfirmed (confidence ~45)**
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SafeSelectorDropdown/components/MultiChainSafeItemRow.tsx:76-79`
- **What:** the badge now shares the line with the chain name, the "N pending" badge and the balance. This row can't shrink: `SelectItem` wraps its children in `ItemText`, which has `flex-1 shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap` (`apps/web/src/components/ui/select.tsx:153`). Because of that, the name's `min-w-0 truncate` probably never cuts the text. The row stays as wide as all its content.
- **Why it matters:** before, the row was as wide as the name or the badge, whichever was longer. Now it is both added together. The popup is `w-[430px] max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]` (`SafeDropdownContainer.tsx:143`). On a phone-width screen, a long chain name plus the Read-only badge (~75px), pending and balance can run past the edge. The balance would then be clipped or cause a sideways scroll, where before it fit.
- **Fix:** put `min-w-0` / `shrink` on the row content, e.g. override `ItemText` for this row, so `truncate` actually works. Also add `shrink-0` to the badge so the name shrinks first. Then check by eye at 320px.
- **Not proven:** I didn't render it in a browser. The not-shrinking wrapper was already there. This commit only adds more content to the same line.

**F2 · P3 · testing · unconfirmed (confidence ~60)**
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SafeSelectorDropdown/SafeSelectorDropdown.stories.tsx:205-219`
- **What:** the stories only show undeployed and activating states on safes with a single chain, and none shows Read-only. No story renders a multi-chain row whose chains are Inactive or Read-only, which is exactly the layout this commit changes. The unit tests (`__tests__/MultiChainSafeItemRow.test.tsx`) replace `SelectItem` with a plain `div` and only check that the badge exists. Reverting the commit would fail no test and change no snapshot. There is also no test for the Read-only badge at all.
- **Why it matters:** `apps/web/AGENTS.md:148` says layout-only changes are covered by a Storybook story. Without one, the visual snapshot check has nothing to catch a regression in this row, including F1.
- **Fix:** add a story (e.g. `MultiChainMixedStatus`) with one multi-chain safe that has a deployed chain, an undeployed chain, and a Read-only chain with `queued > 0`.

## Checked, nothing found

- **Security, regression, performance, architecture:** it's a markup-only change, with no data, API, or stored-state changes. The existing tests use test IDs and aria-labels that are still there.
- **DRY / KISS:** the change removes a wrapper `div`. It still reuses `StatusBadge` / `NotActivatedBadge` rather than adding anything new.
- **Conventions:** the Tailwind usage matches the surrounding code, and the commit message follows the conventional format.

## Worth tidying (optional, no score impact)

1. `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SafeSelectorDropdown/components/MultiChainSafeItemRow.tsx:25`: the Read-only badge is hand-built as a styled `span`. It could use the shared `Badge` component the same file already uses for "N pending" (line 81), about 3 lines.

Fix now, make a ticket, or skip? If you don't answer, I'll treat it as skip.

## Limits

- Nothing was independently checked, so there is no score.
- I didn't render the page, so F1 comes from reading the CSS.
- The `.git/safe-code-review/last-run.tsv` history file wasn't read or written, so there's no "since your last run" comparison.
